caveats: Phases use the most recently received phase marker, not exact engine-time alignment. Queuing and GPU latency make boundary attribution uncertain.
Functions may be truncated to the configured per-frame limit; absent functions are not zero-cost.
Self, total and internal times are separate overlapping metrics; do not add them together. Calls are accumulated only from per-frame messages.
Native entries are script-invoked native call instrumentation, not full C++ sampling.
Visual marker values are raw CPU/GPU millisecond markers, potentially nested timestamps; averages are not independently additive durations.
Frame metrics are seconds. Visual metrics are milliseconds. No GPU duration is inferred when markers are missing.
Capture should contain one profiler session: signature IDs can be reused after restarting profiling.

native_excluded_capture.reason: Timestamp capacity overflow: 2379 errors plus four TOO_MANY_ERRORS notices. Not clean timing evidence.

gpu_fixture_parity.scope: Exact raw GPU pixels for ten production passes on deterministic fixture; not whole-scene or performance proof

validation.opening_highlight_marker: OPENING_HIGHLIGHT_FAILURES=0, exit 0; legacy runner marker mismatch independently checked
validation.limitations: Not all repository tests. Headless tests do not verify Android. Pixel fixture is not a whole-scene screenshot comparison.

setup_hitch.note: Single-frame nested attribution. Do not sum enclosing and child totals. Rebuild happens after two host frames, not inside the initial action call.

source_hash_note: Recorded after validation. After measured export, the highlighter comment was clarified and benchmark effective engine settings logging added; candidate behavior/default are unchanged. Native attribution predates adding the default-off candidate.

formal_launch_provenance.method: One serial PowerShell loop, same literal arguments except candidate switch and per-run log path

final_reporting_export.note: Separate final export after reporting-only additions; not substituted for measured ABBA pack.
